input.name: Fictional cloud Tessaly has a multi-hour outage

echoes.title: Tessaly cloud outage takes down hosted model APIs
echoes.summary: The fictional cloud provider Tessaly had an outage of about five hours in one region; several AI services built on it were unavailable.

echoes.title: 架空のクラウド Tessaly で大規模障害
echoes.summary: Tessaly の一部リージョンで約5時間の障害が発生し、AI サービスが停止した。

echoes.title: Tessaly promises a public incident report
echoes.summary: Tessaly said it will publish a full incident report and offer service credits.
